invitation-display.purpose: The h1 inside the invitation frame; its second line is set in foil.

headline.purpose: Section h2, centred over the diamond rule.

title.purpose: h3 and card titles; 1.55 to 1.8rem on place cards, programme and tariff rows.

figure.purpose: Estimates, totals and servings in foil, tabular.

field-value.purpose: What the visitor writes into the invitation fields.

lead.purpose: Ledes and section intros in ink-soft.

label.purpose: Uppercase foil field labels, table heads, footer column heads, programme times. Never an eyebrow above a heading.

shadows.name: none
shadows.purpose: The world is flat; no drawn shadows. Depth comes from board tone and foil line weight.

shadows.name: foil-stroke-thicken
shadows.purpose: Not elevation: thickens a 1px foil border to 2px on field focus, the selected pack size and written-date focus.

motion.name: ease-letterpress
motion.purpose: The only easing: buttons, toasts, draw-in and settle.

motion.name: state-colour
motion.purpose: Background, colour and border changes on buttons.

motion.name: corner-in
motion.value: .9s, scale(2.2) and opacity 0 to rest, staggered .08s per corner
motion.purpose: Invitation corner marks draw in once on load.

motion.name: rule-in
motion.purpose: Invitation field rule unclips from the centre once on load.

motion.name: settle
motion.purpose: A changed figure (estimate, total) settles into place.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: prefers-reduced-motion: reduce removes all animation and transition

narrative.overview:
Every surface is a letterpress Indian wedding invitation. The page ground is indigo board; line work, labels and figures are stamped in gold foil; lettering is ivory; and one colour, vermilion, is reserved for the action that sends the card. In light mode the same card is printed on ivory stock with antique-gold foil and indigo ink. The quote form is the invitation itself (event, date, venue and guests are written into foil-ruled fields), and the answer comes back as the matching menu card: servings, lines and a double-ruled total.

Density follows the stationery. Public pages are centred and generous, organised by hairline foil rules, never by boxes with shadows. Catalogue, product, quote and admin pages are tighter and lean on ruled rows (programme, tariff, rates, menu lines, data tables), so the same world serves both persuasion and the working order. Depth comes from foil lines and three tones of board, never from drawn shadows; corners are always square; ornament is limited to a small set of drawn devices (the double frame, the diamond-centred rule, corner marks, seals and diamond bullets).

Motion is a single authored gesture: on the invitation, the four foil corners and the field rule draw themselves in once, and changing figures settle with a short blur-in. Everything else changes colour only. Reduced-motion users get no animation at all.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo board by default, ivory card stock in light mode, switched by a theme toggle.
Gold foil for every line, label and figure; vermilion only for the action.
Yatra One for display lettering and figures; Hind for text, labels and controls.
Square corners everywhere; no shadows; depth by foil rules and board tone.
Double-ruled foil frames, diamond-centred rules, corner marks and seals as the ornament vocabulary.
Product imagery is monoline line art filled with the theme's foil.
Placeholder proof is labelled as illustrative in a dashed foil tag.

rules.name: The One Vermilion Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks the action that sends or starts a quote, and nothing decorative. If a screen has two vermilion buttons competing, one of them is a foil button.

rules.name: The Foil Carries Structure Rule
rules.body: Every line, rule, frame and label is foil at one of three strengths (full, soft, faint). Gray hairlines do not exist in this world.

rules.name: The Tinted Secondary Rule
rules.body: Secondary text is ink-soft or ink-mute, tinted toward the indigo; never a neutral gray.

rules.name: The Lettering Rule
rules.body: Yatra One is set at weight 400 with zero tracking, for headings, written field values and money only. Never for body text, labels or buttons.

rules.name: The Tabular Figures Rule
rules.body: Prices, totals, quantities and table cells use tabular, lining numerals so columns of rupees align.

rules.name: The No Kicker Rule
rules.body: Uppercase foil labels name a field, a column or a time; they never sit above a heading as an eyebrow. Headings open on their own, or on a diamond rule.

rules.name: The Letterpress Rule
rules.body: Paper does not float. Nothing casts a shadow, glows or blurs behind glass; importance is shown by a heavier or doubled foil line.

rules.name: The Square Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is zero. No pills, no rounded cards, no circular buttons.

rules.name: The Double Frame Rule
rules.body: A principal card (the invitation, menu card, product label and order panel, calculator, form card, RSVP close) is a 1.5px foil border with a 1px soft-foil outline offset 7px. Repeated items (place cards, figures, KPIs) take a single soft-foil border instead. Corner marks belong to the invitation alone.

dos: **Do** draw every line in foil at full, soft or faint strength, and use board tone for depth.
**Do** keep vermilion for the one action that sends or starts a quote; secondary actions are foil buttons.
**Do** set headings, written field values and money in Yatra One 400; everything else in Hind.
**Do** use tabular, lining numerals for prices, quantities and table cells.
**Do** set principal cards in the double foil frame (1.5px border, 1px soft outline at 7px offset) and repeated items in a single soft-foil border.
**Do** open sections with a centred headline over the diamond-centred rule.
**Do** draw icons as stroked SVG (1.75px, round caps) in currentColor or foil.
**Do** show product imagery as foil-filled line art until real photography exists.
**Do** label every placeholder testimonial, client, statistic or photo with the dashed illustrative tag.
**Do** keep every touch target at 44px or larger and respect reduced motion.
donts: **Don't** round corners or use pills; radius is 0px.
**Don't** draw shadows, glows, glass or backdrop blur.
**Don't** put an uppercase eyebrow or kicker above a heading.
**Don't** use gradient text or gradient fills.
**Don't** use gray for secondary text; use ink-soft or ink-mute.
**Don't** use vermilion for decoration, borders or emphasis in body copy.
**Don't** use Unicode glyphs or emoji as icons.
**Don't** add new motion; the invitation draw-in and the figure settle are the only authored animations.
